report.title: On the MLC Conjecture and the Renormalization Theory in Complex Dynamics
report.outline_title: Mandelbrot 局部连通性与复重整化
report.version_role: Official published ICM2026 Volume 5: Invited Lectures (Sections 9-11), online 2026-07-13. The complete official HTML is the main source; two research papers were consulted only in the pinned, targeted ranges below.

report.question: How do controlled renormalization domains turn quadratic critical-orbit combinatorics into geometric rigidity and local connectivity, and which unbounded satellite and virtual-molecule scales remain outside the established theorems?
report.reading_scope: Read the complete official mathematical HTML: introduction and §§1.1-1.4, §2, §§3.1-3.9, §§4.1-4.5; all named statements, displayed formulas exposed as text, figure captions, acknowledgments, bibliography 1-50 and publication/license metadata. Targeted official PDF text at pp.118-120 supplied the logistic formula (2.2) at p.119. Formula (2.3) was checked against the explicit f_theta definition in official §3.4. PDF screenshot requests failed with cache-miss errors, and no figure-pixel or full-PDF visual inspection is claimed. The independent prereview's arXiv:2512.24171v1 reading is not counted as this author's own reading. The two supplementary papers were selectively read, not read or proved in full.
report.coverage_status: 52 atomic pages, 3601-360Z and 3610-361G, narrative overview 3600 and reference icm2026-dudko. The overview links every atom organically. QL, sector/cylinder, parabolic/Siegel, puzzle, degeneration and the two remaining-problem branches all retain entrances. Real-line/vein MLC and the all-neutral sector operator retain the official manuscript status of references 14 and 19.

proof_scope.3601: Defines filled Julia sets; proves escape radius, compactness, complete invariance and K_0=closed unit disk. Equality with the normal-family Julia boundary is cited.
proof_scope.3602: Defines M by the critical orbit and fully proves its compactness using the radius-two criterion. Critical-orbit connectivity and connectivity of M are cited foundational theorems.
proof_scope.3603: Defines local connectivity using connected neighborhoods; fully proves equivalence with a connected-open basis using components. Path connectivity is only a comparison.
proof_scope.3604: States MLC and cites the Douady-Hubbard small-copy theorem and Yoccoz global reduction. Singleton/diameter equivalence is proved separately in 360O.
proof_scope.3605: Defines hyperbolic components and multiplier coordinate. Critical capture, multiplier uniformization and small-copy existence are cited, not derived.
proof_scope.3606: Fully calculates c(lambda), injectivity, nonvanishing derivative and the two boundary parameters. The period-two attachment is standard cited dynamics.
proof_scope.3607: Fully calculates the logistic affine conjugacy, invariant interval and parameter image; excludes lambda=0 from the invertible conjugacy.
proof_scope.3608: Defines degree-d polynomial-like and quadratic-like maps, properness and filled sets. Verifies the z^2 disk example. Critical-count/connectivity facts are cited.
proof_scope.3609: Defines hybrid equivalence with quasiconformal neighborhood conjugacy and weak dbar h=0 almost everywhere on K. Explains interior conformality and the area-zero case. Reuses the analytic quasiconformal and Beltrami definition in 3907 and weak derivatives in 2J0C.
proof_scope.3610: Defines the phase-dependent Lavaurs map and fully proves its commuting relation where defined. Perturbation/iterate convergence is cited and is not claimed for every converging parameter sequence.
proof_scope.3611: Cites high-type near-parabolic hyperbolicity in the constructed Inou-Shishikura semilocal class for all a_j>N. Gives only the report's strategy, not the computer-assisted or Teichmüller proof.
proof_scope.3612: Cites pacman/Siegel hyperbolicity for bounded rotation numbers of periodic type with one complex unstable dimension. Technical pacman class construction and codimension-one stability proof remain external.
proof_scope.3613: Defines the main molecule and formal continued-fraction compactification, and records Conjectures 3.5-3.6 as open. Does not derive hyperbolicity from a topological model.
proof_scope.3614: Defines nice puzzle pieces and returns under critical recurrence; explains the one critical branch and univalent other branches using the puzzle pullback structure. The puzzle construction remains standard cited theory.
proof_scope.3615: Defines central returns and finite cascades, explains virtual primitive scales, and retains a fixed anti-molecule separation parameter for the large-period estimates.
proof_scope.3616: Defines width as inverse connected exterior modulus and proves the reciprocal degeneration criterion. Horizontal/vertical thick-thin decomposition remains cited and is not asserted additive for arbitrary families.
proof_scope.3617: Fully proves an abstract first-record bound after stating the required quantitative amplification hypothesis. Kahn-Lyubich rectangle pullback and the p-dependent error absorption are cited inputs; unbounded periods are excluded from uniformity.
proof_scope.3618: Fully derives the serial-width numerical implication and contradiction between persistent faster-than-exponential growth and an exponential upper bound. Wave Lemma, layer selection and conversion to QL moduli remain external.
proof_scope.3619: States the official pseudo-Siegel theorem at its stated construction scope and the precise bounded-type uniform outer-quasidisk theorem. Does not promote deep renormalized geometry to a uniform original-plane bound for every layer.
proof_scope.360A: States degree-d straightening and uniqueness for connected K as a cited theorem. Fully proves uniqueness of the centered monic quadratic parameter by coefficient comparison.
proof_scope.360B: Defines DH quadratic-like renormalization with degree-two restriction, connected little K and disjoint/satellite intersection condition. Defines affine normalization and distinguishes parameter-orbit rescaling.
proof_scope.360C: Defines primitive and satellite types through the orbit of a distinctly named base little filled Julia set. Satellite bouquets can be permuted along a cycle rather than sharing one contact point globally. Parameter interpretation is cited.
proof_scope.360D: Defines bounded relative periods and proves total-period product growth. Allows mixed primitive/satellite sequences; distinguishes rotation arithmetic.
proof_scope.360E: Defines annulus modulus through cited uniformization. Calculates logarithmic-cylinder model, similarity invariance and degree-d covering factor.
proof_scope.360F: Defines general curve-family extremal length/width; proves conformal invariance and the exact rectangular and annular crossing values by Cauchy-Schwarz.
proof_scope.360G: Gives the density proof of the serial Grötzsch inequality and its reciprocal-width formulation.
proof_scope.360H: Defines a priori and beau bounds with B, initial-modulus lower bound, entry time and tail bound in the correct quantifier order. Normalized-germ compactness is cited; mod and mod+ are not identified.
proof_scope.360I: Fully proves compact restriction H-infinity(U) to H-infinity(U') using Cauchy estimates, finite nets, diagonal subsequences and holomorphic limits.
proof_scope.360J: Cites complex-codimension-one analytic hybrid leaves and the local analytic equation for the fixed base map's leaf. Does not assert an analytic simultaneous transverse classification of all leaves.
proof_scope.360K: Defines uniform hyperbolicity for a Banach analytic operator with stable/unstable inequalities, complex dimension and noninvertible orbit-history qualification. No dynamical hyperbolicity proof.
proof_scope.360L: For the fixed bound B, cites exponential attraction only for infinitely renormalizable maps with every relative period at most B. Local norms, entry time and prefactor are distinguished from the horseshoe contraction rate. Research compactness, spectra and transverse expansion remain external.
proof_scope.360M: Cites beau bounds for all bounded QL combinatorics, including mixed types, and dynamical/parameter local connectivity. Separates the research proof from its degeneration outline.
proof_scope.360N: Fully checks B=2 and derives Feigenbaum MLC from 360M. Existence of the classical parameter and universality remain cited inputs.
proof_scope.360O: Fully proves the nested compact singleton criterion in a metric space, including nonempty intersection and the subsequence contradiction.
proof_scope.360P: Fully proves diameter shrinkage under explicit area/diameter and disjointness hypotheses. Uniform quasiconformal geometry is a conjectural input; its area distortion implication is cited.
proof_scope.360Q: Defines partially defined first return and normalization; proves scale cancellation in its derivative on each fixed branch. Outside that domain the polynomial extension is not a first-return map.
proof_scope.360R: Defines independent parameter and dynamical scales; derives u_0=1, u_{k+1}=2w_k u_k+1 and parameter derivative delta/eta times (u_q-1).
proof_scope.360S: Retains expansion/balance and precompactness as a conjectural framework; records all/some branch distinction and that normal limits can be constant.
proof_scope.360T: Fully computes the neutral quadratic translation, parameter, critical point and critical value; distinguishes rational parabolic and irrational neutral multipliers.
proof_scope.360U: Defines linearization, Siegel and Cremer; fully derives the second-order small divisor. Bounded-type quasidisk geometry and the critical boundary point are cited.
proof_scope.360V: Defines continued fractions, bounded and high type. Supplies convergent recursion, determinant identity and exact tail-error identity explaining alternation.
proof_scope.360W: Fully verifies golden-mean continued fractions, Fibonacci denominators and signed return error. Dynamical convergence is not deduced from arithmetic alone.
proof_scope.360X: Describes sector return, commuting branches and gluing by the current map; retains the >1 condition for the simple signed-tail formula. Existence of admissible sectors is cited.
proof_scope.360Y: Defines a separating-annulus bound for the whole finite return orbit and explains the compact-restriction step. All-neutral operator construction remains report reference 19, a manuscript.
proof_scope.360Z: States the Fatou-coordinate existence theorem as cited and fully computes the approximate translation u -> u+1+1/(u-1), plus the cylinder quotient.
proof_scope.361A: States existence of an invariant full continuum containing the neutral and critical points with a homeomorphic restriction. Fully proves containment of the postcritical set and bounded-orbit consequence; existence remains cited.
proof_scope.361B: States Problem 4.3 for remaining unbounded satellite combinations. Explains why neither bounded QL nor exactly neutral estimates directly solve it.
proof_scope.361C: States Problem 4.4 and the finite-return nature of virtual Julia objects. It is a proposed interpolation framework, not an invariant-set existence theorem.
proof_scope.361D: Retains the unified one-unstable-direction operator and boundary-area consequences as open questions. Cites boundary Hausdorff dimension two without inferring positive area.
proof_scope.361E: States Böttcher uniformization for connected filled K and Carathéodory extension with local-connectivity hypothesis as cited theorems. Derives ray-angle and potential dynamics; distinguishes semiconjugacy, Jordan injectivity and parameter coordinates.
proof_scope.361F: Defines nested boundary tilings, bounded combinatorics and inner/outer width controls. Cites the K(C,M) quasidisk criterion; no full welding proof or pseudo-disk construction is claimed.
proof_scope.361G: Defines Hubbard-tree core entropy in the PCF finite-tree setting, reusing topological entropy. Tree existence and canonical regulated arcs are cited; a fixed positive lower bound is distinguished from mere positivity.

remaining_branches: Complete MLC and uniform geometry of all hyperbolic components remain conjectural.
All-rotation neutral and molecule hyperbolicity remain Conjectures 3.5-3.6.
Unbounded satellite pseudo-Siegel estimates remain Problem 4.3.
A single global hyperbolic framework and boundary area zero remain open; no statistical theorem is supplied by this report.
normalization_notes: Quadratic family p_c=z^2+c; neutral family f_theta=e^(2*pi*i*theta)z+z^2 is related by a specified translation.
QL renormalization is iteration/restriction/affine normalization, not the algebraic parameter-orbit rescaling of 0K1L.
Bounded QL type means bounded relative periods; bounded rotation type means bounded continued-fraction entries; high type means all entries>N.
The local analytic tau equation in Lemma 3.2 defines the fixed base hybrid leaf only; no analytic simultaneous transverse foliation coordinate is asserted.
True prerequisite edges omit comparison, applications and proof-outline navigation. In particular 3605->3604, 360V->360D and 360X->360Y are not prerequisite edges.

The existing 2Q0Z concerns quasicircles and conformal welding; it is not substituted for the analytic definition. 361F concerns nested boundary tiling geometry. 360F extends the generic curve-family definition rather than duplicating the closed-curve/extremal-volume theorem in 2Q0O.
